items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1958-05-31
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of Bill Russell. The name 'Bill' appears only as the interviewer addressing the interviewee (e.g., 'you want me to give my name, Bill?', 'I can tell you a lot about him, Bill').

ctx.x: Okay, Mr. Dominant, you might give your name on here again.
Alright, you want me to give my name, Bill? Daddy Dominant. Cornelius.
Can you tell me a little bit about your teacher, Manuel Perez?
